framing: Each hypothesis is a falsifiable mechanism candidate. Simple durable orchestration is a subfunction/cost comparator, not an architecture-equivalent null for organism-level operational closure.

hypotheses.title: Operational-Closure Irreducibility
hypotheses.claim: Output-equivalent workflows are not architecture-equivalent unless they reproduce endogenous state→action→world→verified-outcome→credit→re-entry closure plus persistent control/goal state.
hypotheses.counter: A much smaller closed-loop controller may preserve the relevant closure signatures, so Frank's internal richness may still be compressible.

hypotheses.title: Typed Multi-Timescale Controllers
hypotheses.claim: Local controllers at different timescales beat one global stability scalar.
hypotheses.counter: One global controller may coordinate adequately at lower complexity.

hypotheses.title: Provenance-Bound Closure
hypotheses.claim: Re-entry is closed only when producer/state/receipt/source bindings remain valid; identical outcome is insufficient.
hypotheses.counter: Outcome+receiver use may dominate provenance in practice.

hypotheses.title: Adaptive Recurrence Error Dynamics
hypotheses.claim: Continue recurrence only when expected correction exceeds error-introduction, cost and instability while unresolved pressure remains.
hypotheses.counter: Fixed shallow recurrence may be more robust OOD.

hypotheses.title: Productive Limit Cycles
hypotheses.claim: Bounded non-convergent recurrence can remain causally useful.
hypotheses.counter: Useful cognition may ultimately benefit from fixed-point-like termination.

hypotheses.title: Operating Region over Point Optimum
hypotheses.claim: Binary freeze should select a reproducible attractor/operating region, not a lucky peak.
hypotheses.counter: A sharp optimum may dominate under negligible deployment variance.

hypotheses.title: Slow Pressure Shapes Fast Planning
hypotheses.claim: Persistent goals/homeostatic pressures causally bias fast planning across interruptions.
hypotheses.counter: Explicit objective+task state may reproduce the effect.

hypotheses.title: U-Shaped Re-entry Depth
hypotheses.claim: Intermediate re-entry depth dominates too little and too much.
hypotheses.counter: The relation may be monotonic or task-specific.

hypotheses.title: Local Stability Proxies
hypotheses.claim: Local Jacobian/spectral/gain proxies predict some instabilities.
hypotheses.counter: They may predict numerical stability but not cognitive utility.

hypotheses.title: CognitiveCycleShadow Early Warning
hypotheses.claim: Phase/resource/state shadows predict stagnation or divergence before terminal failure.
hypotheses.counter: Instrumentation may perturb timing and add noncausal correlations.

hypotheses.title: Selective Simulative Planning
hypotheses.claim: Expensive prospective/world-model planning should be invoked only when self-regulation predicts incremental value.
hypotheses.counter: Always-on shallow planning may be simpler and equivalent at v0.1 scale.

hypotheses.title: Co-Regulation Monitor
hypotheses.claim: A non-authoritative monitor can reduce fixation without becoming a second agent identity.
hypotheses.counter: The main loop can self-regulate sufficiently.

hypotheses.title: Dual Workspace Complementarity
hypotheses.claim: NativeModelWorkspace and ClayGWT can contribute distinct functions on complex tasks.
hypotheses.counter: They may be redundant, antagonistic or model-specific.

hypotheses.title: Double-Workspace Overcoupling
hypotheses.claim: Rebroadcast between native and Clay workspaces can create redundant recurrence and diversity collapse.
hypotheses.counter: Cross-workspace reinforcement may improve difficult reasoning.

hypotheses.title: Bandwidth-Limited Workspace
hypotheses.claim: Selective bottleneck competition protects specialization better than full broadcast.
hypotheses.counter: Broad broadcast may be cheap and beneficial in one module.

hypotheses.title: Receiver Use over Ignition
hypotheses.claim: Receiver reconstruction/use predicts utility better than one ignition scalar.
hypotheses.counter: Ignition may summarize the bottleneck cheaply.

hypotheses.title: Consume-Bound GWT Closure
hypotheses.claim: GWT re-entry/learning requires exact consumer-side producer/storage/provenance validation.
hypotheses.counter: Producer-side signed receipts may suffice under trusted storage.

hypotheses.title: Binary-Bound Latent Probes
hypotheses.claim: Latent probes are model/build/quantization/basis scoped and require post-binary revalidation.
hypotheses.counter: Some robust features may transfer without recalibration.

hypotheses.title: Observability Is Not Actionability
hypotheses.claim: Decode quality and causal control quality are separate axes.
hypotheses.counter: Strong probes may correlate enough with useful interventions.

hypotheses.title: Workspace Discordance Signal
hypotheses.claim: Calibrated native-vs-Clay workspace disagreement predicts hidden strategy/error/overcoupling.
hypotheses.counter: Discordance may mostly be probe noise/non-identifiability.

hypotheses.title: Execution vs Semantic Memory
hypotheses.claim: Execution-state and semantic memory remain distinct but state-witness bound.
hypotheses.counter: One typed store may provide sufficient separation without plane distinction.

hypotheses.title: Bitemporal Semantic Validity
hypotheses.claim: Valid-time plus transaction/admission-time improve stale-fact and contradiction handling.
hypotheses.counter: Existing epochs/provenance may suffice.

hypotheses.title: Immutable Episodes plus Current-Belief Projection
hypotheses.claim: Preserve source episodes while maintaining adjudicated replaceable current belief.
hypotheses.counter: In-place updates plus audit logs may be cheaper.

hypotheses.title: Active Branch Execution State
hypotheses.claim: Root-to-active-leaf state trees improve rollback, error isolation and bounded context.
hypotheses.counter: Linear checkpoints/summaries may match the benefit.

hypotheses.title: Conflict Resolution as Write Governance
hypotheses.claim: Contradiction adjudication is a write/admission governance problem, not only retrieval ranking.
hypotheses.counter: Query-time contextual resolution may preserve conflicts more safely.

hypotheses.title: Cheap Candidate Generation, Expensive Rerank
hypotheses.claim: Hash/keyword/temporal/typed/graph filters should precede expensive semantic reasoning.
hypotheses.counter: Simple typed/embedding retrieval may already dominate at v0.1 scale.

hypotheses.title: StateWitness Revalidation
hypotheses.claim: Reads later used for mutation/effect require revalidation after state turnover.
hypotheses.counter: Transactions/current epoch may already prevent material stale use.

hypotheses.title: SelectionWitness
hypotheses.claim: Candidate-universe/policy/result provenance is distinct from record provenance.
hypotheses.counter: Selected refs plus query may be enough.

hypotheses.title: Hierarchical Incremental Commitment
hypotheses.claim: Dirty-domain commitments can avoid expensive full-state hashing while retaining auditability.
hypotheses.counter: Cache invalidation risk may dominate saved compute.

hypotheses.title: Materialization Is Not Semantic Identity
hypotheses.claim: Actual schema/materialization attestation and semantic state identity are orthogonal.
hypotheses.counter: Migration metadata plus tests may sufficiently imply materialization.

hypotheses.title: Storage Capability Vector
hypotheses.claim: Storage compatibility binds version, source/object identity and required feature vector.
hypotheses.counter: Version floor plus behavioral smoke may suffice.

hypotheses.title: Selective Event Sourcing
hypotheses.claim: Event-source authority/replay-critical transitions; keep caches/projections mutable/rebuildable.
hypotheses.counter: Universal event sourcing may simplify consistency enough to justify cost.

hypotheses.title: Hyperposition Branch DAG
hypotheses.claim: Semantic alternatives can be a branch DAG with active leaf and preserved ancestry.
hypotheses.counter: Set-valued Hyperposition may be simpler and sufficient.

hypotheses.title: Pairwise-First Higher Order
hypotheses.claim: Promote order>2 only after irreducible incremental causal utility over pairwise representation.
hypotheses.counter: Higher-order structures may be cheap and useful enough as default.

hypotheses.title: Synergistic Causality for Distributed Organs
hypotheses.claim: PEID/PID-like synergy may reveal distributed causal functions missed by pairwise lesions.
hypotheses.counter: Estimator sensitivity may add no actionable value over factorial lesions.

hypotheses.title: Latent Equivalence Hyperpositions
hypotheses.claim: Non-identifiable latent vectors/features remain equivalence hypotheses, not canonical identities.
hypotheses.counter: Behavioral equivalence may be sufficient for runtime control.

hypotheses.title: Controlled Branch Reopening
hypotheses.claim: Reopening alternatives can reseed escape from stale attractors.
hypotheses.counter: It may revive known-bad paths and destabilize convergence.

hypotheses.title: ClayGraph Source-Root Binding
hypotheses.claim: Graph validity binds exact semantic root and selected continuation head, not epoch alone.
hypotheses.counter: Epoch+transaction may suffice if sibling states are impossible.

hypotheses.title: Deterministic GraphProjectionRoot
hypotheses.claim: Derived graph emits deterministic root bound to source and materializer identity.
hypotheses.counter: Projection tests/source root may suffice without another commitment.

hypotheses.title: Causal Signature for Emergent Organ Replacement
hypotheses.claim: Distributed successor must preserve lesion/rescue causal signatures, not only output equality.
hypotheses.counter: Outcome-equivalent internal causal change may be acceptable.

hypotheses.title: Selective Typing Hardness
hypotheses.claim: Maximal typing/effects at identity/state/provenance/authority boundaries; aggressively lower ordinary internals.
hypotheses.counter: Uniform typing may simplify invariants.

hypotheses.title: Executable Semantic Differential
hypotheses.claim: Executable source→evaluator/compiler differential mutation tests outrank textual marker conformance.
hypotheses.counter: A complete formal proof could supersede differential testing.

hypotheses.title: Formal Context for ClayCode Generation
hypotheses.claim: Grammar/API/permitted vocabulary improve generated ClayCode structural validity before training.
hypotheses.counter: A final Clay-native model may internalize the language enough to make runtime context redundant.

hypotheses.title: Lowering Agreement Is Correlated Evidence
hypotheses.claim: Python/C lowerings sharing semantic ancestry are not independent replications.
hypotheses.counter: Diverse toolchains can still expose independent implementation bugs.

hypotheses.title: Fail-Closed Unknown Semantics
hypotheses.claim: Unsupported constructs remain unresolved/refused rather than inheriting host semantics.
hypotheses.counter: Conservative host semantics may accelerate harmless constructs.

hypotheses.title: Typed Recurrence Budgets
hypotheses.claim: Bounded fixpoint/recurrence semantics can make runaway loops explicit policy/type violations.
hypotheses.counter: Runtime counters may be simpler than language-level types.

hypotheses.title: Fast Compiled Control plus Slow Strategic Recompile
hypotheses.claim: Fast deterministic ClayCode control plus slower model strategic policy recompilation improves timescale separation.
hypotheses.counter: Dynamic LLM control may adapt better without compilation boundaries.

hypotheses.title: ResumeCompatibilityFingerprint
hypotheses.claim: Resume validates binary/build, ClayCode/compiler, schema/state and loop topology/config or explicit migration relation.
hypotheses.counter: Existing migrations/state versions may already cover enough.

hypotheses.title: Receipt-Fold Reward
hypotheses.claim: Rebuild reward from verified terminal outcome/credit receipts to prevent duplicate consumption by construction.
hypotheses.counter: Transactional mutable accumulator may be simpler/faster and equally safe.

hypotheses.title: No Self-Reward Laundering
hypotheses.claim: Self-generated activity cannot mint material reward without independent verified outcome+credit.
hypotheses.counter: Bounded intrinsic competence/curiosity can exist separately from material reward.

hypotheses.title: Multidimensional Reward/Pressure
hypotheses.claim: Typed multi-timescale control/reward dimensions resist Goodhart better than one scalar.
hypotheses.counter: They may merely hide implicit scalarization and add tuning complexity.

hypotheses.title: Timescale-Factorized Personality
hypotheses.claim: Identity, role persona, fast appraisal and slow regulatory personality remain separate states.
hypotheses.counter: One persistent vector/profile may give comparable consistency cheaper.

hypotheses.title: Fast Appraisal Cannot Directly Rewrite Slow Personality
hypotheses.claim: Fast appraisal may route urgency/conflict; slow personality remains outcome+credit gated.
hypotheses.counter: Repeated high-confidence appraisal may warrant a bounded low-rate adaptation path.

hypotheses.title: Capability Self-Model from Verified Outcomes
hypotheses.claim: Tool/peer routing improves when capability estimates update from verified performance/cost/failure.
hypotheses.counter: Static declarations plus retry/fallback may suffice at v0.1 scale.

hypotheses.title: Adaptive Goal Shaping
hypotheses.claim: Goal shaping should balance exploitation and epistemic exploration dynamically.
hypotheses.counter: Persistent hard priorities may be safer for user-aligned reliability.

hypotheses.title: Consume-Bound Provenance with Typed Subcontracts
hypotheses.claim: A small shared consume-bound vocabulary can unify verification while keeping branch-specific typed constraints.
hypotheses.counter: Universal abstraction may be more complex than local guards.

hypotheses.title: Lease Epoch Is Not Stream Sequence
hypotheses.claim: Authority fencing and client delivery/replay need distinct monotonic clocks.
hypotheses.counter: Event IDs/idempotency keys may remove need for dedicated stream sequence.

hypotheses.title: Consumer-Side Verification
hypotheses.claim: Provenance is insufficient until exact consumer checks expectations before consequential use.
hypotheses.counter: Central trusted verification may avoid repeated consumer checks.

hypotheses.title: Trusted First Import-Capable Boundary
hypotheses.claim: Boot establishes trusted interpreter/package roots before import-capable paths can influence Frank.
hypotheses.counter: Post-start artifact hashing may provide equivalent assurance with less boot complexity.

hypotheses.title: Conjunctive ProductStart
hypotheses.claim: Trusted build+selected lineage+identity+storage runtime+installed entrypoint+lease+restart/recovery form a conjunction; one green component never substitutes.
hypotheses.counter: A smaller root attestation set may logically imply several gates and avoid gate explosion.

rejected_general_rules: open durable workflow == organism-level Frank architecture
